title: KCS U3c (f) RUN: the NAMED-candidate screen on the seven recorded residual points - the (e) family extended with f8 = delta(X)*(loglog X/log X) (the DERIVED next-order product term of the LOS q=4 expansion, the 0188 named candidate) and f11 = loglog X (a bare growing line, in the test space because the measured 0187 excess grows in X). Findings: (a) the derived 2-term form R ~ a*(ll/l)^2 + b*delta*ll/l SURVIVES the screening bar (chi2 = 3.88 / 5 dof, max resid 1.86 se) with coefficient signs (-1.881, +3.695) - a CANCELLATION structure: the two fitted terms are ~8x the size of R itself (at 1e10: +0.0392 from the product term minus 0.0347 from the leading term = +0.0045 = R); (c) the derived 3-term form + f11 loglog line is the statistically best named form (chi2 = 3.26 / 4 dof, max 1.51 se) but the bare growing line's coefficient is +0.00019, effectively ZERO; (b) reference (e)-best pair f2 + f6: chi2 = 3.56/5 dof, max 1.76 se; (d) f2+f11 chi2 7.26 max 2.46se; (e) f8+f11 chi2 6.65 max 2.38se - also passing but inferior. KEY FINDING: the bare growing loglog line is NOT picked up by ANY in-sample named fit (coefficient ~1e-4 in every variant that contains it) - the 0187 slowly growing excess (measured +6.68e-04/+8.32e-04/+9.99e-04 at 1e10/3e10/1e11; the 3-point ~(loglog X)^4.2 hint of 0188) is reproduced IN-SAMPLE instead by the cancellation of two DECAYING terms (-f2 + f8): f8 = delta*(ll/l) decays slower than f2 = (ll/l)^2 over the ladder, so the net combination decays slower than either alone - the 'growth' of the excess over 1e10..1e11 is an appearance of the cancellation, and the 3-point excess fit with the 7-point fit PREFER DIFFERENT DESCRIPTIONS (both recorded honestly; the 3-point statistics carried the (loglog)^4.2 shape, the 7-point inverse-variance fit prefers the decay-cancellation). What this is NOT: the derived structure is DATA-COMPATIBLE (the 2-term form passes at 1.86 se) but NOT CONFIRMED - the (-, +) sign structure with ~8x term cancellation is not the naive positive-leading derived form of 0186-ansatz-A (which had C ~ +0.23..+0.30 flat for the single-term fit), and 7 points cannot discriminate among the ~8 now-compatible families (the discriminators 3e11/1e12 remain beyond this box: 0187 memory ceiling). The strict-CI gate stays OPEN. No RH claim: R is the prime-gap class census residual over exact integer sieves; the family screen is a mechanism-narrowing step, flank work, not a law.
claim: Unit U3c (f) of the KCS program (named in the 0188 verdict): on the SEVEN recorded residual points (no new sieving, all values from the record 0170/0171/0173/0186/0187; seconds of arithmetic), the ansatz family of 0188 is extended with (i) f8 = delta(X)*(loglog X/log X), the first product term of the LOS q=4 consecutive-pair expansion, delta(X) = log(2 pi log X / 4)/(2 log X) the verified LOS delta factor - this is the DERIVED candidate (the next term of a known expansion, not a free fit); (ii) f11 = loglog X, a bare growing line, included because the measured 0187 excess grows in X and the test space must contain a growing candidate. Five named candidate structures were fitted (inverse-variance weighted, residuals in se units, chi2 with dof = 7 - params): (a) R ~ a*f2 + b*f8 (the pure derived 2-term form): chi2 = 3.88 / 5 dof, max resid 1.86 se - PASSES the screening bar; coefficients a = -1.88114 (f2), b = +3.69471 (f8); signs (-, +); at 1e10 the product term alone is +0.0392, the leading term alone -0.0347, net +0.0045 = R(1e10) = +0.004307 within 0.1 se - an ~8x-magnitude cancellation; the per-point residuals: +1.9/-0.5/-0.1/+0.0/-0.1/-0.3/+0.2 se (no systematic pattern, the 1e7 point carries the largest); (b) R ~ a*f2 + b*f6 (the 0188 best pair, reference): chi2 = 3.56/5 dof, max 1.76 se, a = +0.09899, b = +1.30955 - positive-positive, no cancellation; (c) R ~ a*f2 + b*f8 + c*f11 (derived + growing line): chi2 = 3.26/4 dof, max 1.51 se - the best chi2 of the named forms; a = -3.26774, b = +6.06274, c = +0.00019 (the loglog-line coefficient is effectively ZERO); residuals +1.5/-0.9/-0.3/-0.1/+0.2/+0.1/-0.1 se; (d) R ~ a*f2 + b*f11: chi2 = 7.26/5 dof, max 2.46 se, b = -0.00029 (line dead); (e) R ~ a*f8 + b*f11: chi2 = 6.65/5 dof, max 2.38 se, b = -0.00025 (line dead). The structural finding: in EVERY named fit that contains the bare growing line f11, its coefficient collapses to ~|c| < 3e-4 - the in-sample data do not need a growing 1-parameter line at all; the slow-growth appearance of the 0187 excess over 1e10..1e11 (where it looked like a ~(loglog X)^4.2 hint on 3 points) is reproduced by the decay-cancellation of two decaying terms: f8/f2 = delta(X) (the slow-LOS-delta ratio) and f2 decays faster than f8, so -a*f2 + b*f8 with a,b > 0 decays SLOWER than either factor - and over the tail of the ladder (1e10..1e11) the cancellation net is measured to be flattening (the residual trajectory of (c) is flat at +0.2/+0.1/-0.1 se in that tail). The two descriptions are in mild tension (3-point excess fit vs 7-point fit); both are recorded; neither is a law. Interpretive status: the DERIVED 2-term form is now a data-compatible candidate for the residual structure of the U3 class residual (first time a purely derived form passes the screen - 0186/0187's fitted forms all FAILED out-of-sample, this one is in-sample by construction and its out-of-sample behavior at 3e11/1e12 is the named discriminator, unmeasurable on this box per 0187); the strict-CI gate (derived correction landing INSIDE the CI of the measurement, out-of-sample) remains OPEN on the usual grounds. No RH claim; flank work; no gating of the mainstream.
